script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: The guest-list joke makes light of the nations receiving the cup of wrath.
The passage does not say whether Jeremiah is among those who drink.
“No arguing, no stalling” asserts details the passage does not give.
Saying Papa would not have been “that steady” presents Jeremiah as steady, which the passage does not say.
The passage does not say the cup stays with whoever receives it; Jeremiah makes multiple nations drink from it.
“The text gives them no extra time” adds a detail about timing that the passage does not give.
The statement that Nineveh is the capital of Assyria is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The explanation is flat and repetitive, restating the verse without adding a distinctive voice or useful clarification.
The kitchen-tune joke makes the LORD’s roar the subject of humor.
Noah is mentioned without a brief introduction identifying who he is.
The hiding-place joke makes light of the shepherds’ inability to escape the slaughter.
The explanation is generic and repetitive, with little of Papa Dorin’s voice.
